problem:
For a real number \(p\in(1,\infty)\) and a positive integer \(n\), equip \(\mathbb R^n\) with the distance
\[
d_p(x,y)=\biggl(\sum_{j=1}^{n}|x_j-y_j|^p\biggr)^{1/p}.
\]
A finite subset \(S\subset\mathbb R^n\) is equilateral if there exists a real number \(r>0\) such that \(d_p(x,y)=r\) for every two distinct points \(x,y\in S\). Determine exactly the set of exponents \(p\in(1,\infty)\) for which, for every positive integer \(n\), every equilateral subset of \((\mathbb R^n,d_p)\) has at most \(n+1\) elements. Give the parameter set in interval notation.
title: 等距離点集合の上限を決める指数
translation_ja: 実数p∈(1,∞)と正整数nに対し、ℝⁿに距離dₚ(x,y)=(Σⱼ₌₁ⁿ|xⱼ−yⱼ|ᵖ)^(1/p)を入れる。有限部分集合S⊂ℝⁿが等距離であるとは、ある実数r>0が存在して、異なる任意のx,y∈Sに対しdₚ(x,y)=rとなることをいう。すべての正整数nについて、(ℝⁿ,dₚ)のどの等距離部分集合も高々n+1個の要素を持つような指数p∈(1,∞)の集合を厳密に求めよ。区間表記で答えよ。
display_original: For a real number p∈(1,∞) and a positive integer n, equip ℝ^n with the distance d_p(x,y)=(Σ_(j=1)^(n)|x_j-y_j|^p)^(1/p). A finite subset S⊂ℝ^n is equilateral if there exists a real number r>0 such that d_p(x,y)=r for every two distinct points x,y∈ S. Determine exactly the set of exponents p∈(1,∞) for which, for every positive integer n, every equilateral subset of (ℝ^n,d_p) has at most n+1 elements. Give the parameter set in interval notation.
reference_description_ja: p>4で等距離点集合の大きさに関するKusner予想の反例を構成する。

problem: For each positive integer \(n\), let \(a(n)\) be the least nonnegative integer \(m\) for which there exist integers \(x_0,\ldots,x_m\) with \(x_0=1\), \(x_m=n\), and the following property: for every \(k=1,\ldots,m\), there are indices \(0\le i,j<k\) such that \(x_k\) equals one of \(x_i+x_j\), \(x_i-x_j\), or \(x_i x_j\). The indices \(i,j\) may be equal, earlier values may be reused, and intermediate values have no sign or magnitude restrictions. Determine the increasing ordered tuple of all primes \(p<5000\) satisfying \(a(p)<a(p-1)\).
title: 短い計算で作れる素数
paper_title: Counterexamples to a conjecture of Kamenetsky on OEIS A173419
translation_ja: 正整数nについて、a(n)を次の条件を満たす最小の非負整数mとする。整数x₀,…,xₘが存在し、x₀=1、xₘ=nであり、k=1,…,mの各段階で、ある添字0≤i,j<kを使ってxₖをxᵢ+xⱼ、xᵢ−xⱼ、xᵢxⱼのいずれかにできる。iとjは同じでもよく、それ以前の値は再利用でき、中間値の符号や大きさに制限はない。a(p)<a(p−1)を満たす5000未満の素数pをすべて求め、昇順の組で答えよ。
display_original: For each positive integer n, let a(n) be the least nonnegative integer m for which there exist integers x_0,…,x_m with x_0=1, x_m=n, and the following property: for every k=1,…,m, there are indices 0≤ i,j<k such that x_k equals one of x_i+x_j, x_i-x_j, or x_i x_j. The indices i,j may be equal, earlier values may be reused, and intermediate values have no sign or magnitude restrictions. Determine the increasing ordered tuple of all primes p<5000 satisfying a(p)<a(p-1).
reference_description_ja: 加減乗算の最短手数に関する予想に対し、5000未満の四つの素数で反例を示す。

problem: For each integer \(s\ge 3\), let \(D_s\) be the least positive integer \(d\) with the following property: for every collection of \(2^s-2\) Borel probability measures on \(\mathbb R^d\), each absolutely continuous with respect to \(d\)-dimensional Lebesgue measure, there exist two affine hyperplanes whose complement has exactly four connected components, each having measure \(1/4\) for every measure in the collection. The same pair of hyperplanes must work for all the measures, and no perpendicularity condition is imposed. What is the exact value of \(D_s\) as a function of \(s\)?
title: 二つの超平面で測度を四等分
paper_title: Counterexamples to the Ramos conjecture for two hyperplanes
translation_ja: 整数s≥3ごとに、次の性質を持つ最小の正整数dをDₛとする。ℝᵈ上の2ˢ−2個のボレル確率測度を任意に選ぶ。各測度はd次元ルベーグ測度に関して絶対連続とする。このとき、二つのアフィン超平面が存在し、その補集合はちょうど四つの連結成分に分かれ、どの成分もすべての測度について測度1/4を持つ。同じ二つの超平面をすべての測度に使い、直交条件は課さない。Dₛをsの関数として厳密に求めよ。
display_original: For each integer s≥ 3, let D_s be the least positive integer d with the following property: for every collection of 2^s-2 Borel probability measures on ℝ^d, each absolutely continuous with respect to d-dimensional Lebesgue measure, there exist two affine hyperplanes whose complement has exactly four connected components, each having measure 1/4 for every measure in the collection. The same pair of hyperplanes must work for all the measures, and no perpendicularity condition is imposed. What is the exact value of D_s as a function of s?
reference_description_ja: 二つの超平面による測度の同時四等分を調べ、Ramos予想の反例と必要次元を示す。

problem:
For a positive integer \(s\), consider the following iteration in exact real arithmetic. Let \(n\ge1\), let \(A\in\mathbb R^{n\times n}\) satisfy \(A^\top=A\) and \(v^\top Av>0\) for every nonzero \(v\in\mathbb R^n\), and choose \(b,x_0\in\mathbb R^n\). Define
\[
x_*=A^{-1}b,\qquad r_k=b-Ax_k,\qquad \|v\|_A=(v^\top Av)^{1/2}.
\]
If \(r_k=0\), terminate. Otherwise, set
\[
\mathcal K_s(A,r_k)=\operatorname{span}\{r_k,Ar_k,\ldots,A^{s-1}r_k\}
\]
and let \(x_{k+1}\) be the unique minimizer of \(\|x_*-z\|_A\) over \(z\in x_k+\mathcal K_s(A,r_k)\). Each such minimization is one restart block, so \(k\) counts blocks. For a nonterminating orbit, define
\[
y_k=\frac{r_k}{\|r_k\|_2},\qquad \|v\|_2=(v^\top v)^{1/2}.
\]
Determine the smallest positive integer \(s\) for which there exist \(n,A,b,x_0\) as above such that \(r_k\ne0\) for every \(k\ge0\), but \((y_{2k})_{k\ge0}\) does not converge in Euclidean norm. Return \(+\infty\) if no such integer exists.
title: 再始動反復法の非収束
authors: Matthew J. Colbrook; George Stepaniants; Alex Townsend
paper_title: A Complete Resolution of Forsythe's Conjecture for Restarted Conjugate Gradients
translation_ja: 正整数sを固定し、厳密な実数演算による次の反復を考える。n≥1とし、実行列A∈ℝⁿˣⁿは対称かつ正定値、b,x₀∈ℝⁿとする。x*=A⁻¹b、rₖ=b−Axₖ、‖v‖ₐ=(vᵀAv)^(1/2)と定める。rₖ=0なら終了する。それ以外ではKₛ(A,rₖ)=span{rₖ,Arₖ,…,A^(s−1)rₖ}と置き、xₖ₊₁をxₖ+Kₛ(A,rₖ)上で‖x*−z‖ₐを最小にする唯一の点とする。この最小化1回を一つの再始動ブロックとし、kはブロック数を数える。終了しない軌道ではyₖ=rₖ/‖rₖ‖₂、‖v‖₂=(vᵀv)^(1/2)と定める。すべてのk≥0でrₖ≠0だが、部分列(y₂ₖ)ₖ≥₀がユークリッドノルムで収束しないようなn,A,b,x₀が存在する、最小の正整数sを求めよ。存在しなければ+∞と答えよ。
display_original: For a positive integer s, consider the following iteration in exact real arithmetic. Let n≥1, let A∈ℝ^(n× n) satisfy A^T=A and v^T Av>0 for every nonzero v∈ℝ^n, and choose b,x_0∈ℝ^n. Define x_*=A^(-1)b, r_k=b-Ax_k, ‖v‖_A=(v^T Av)^(1/2). If r_k=0, terminate. Otherwise, set K_s(A,r_k)=span{r_k,Ar_k,…,A^(s-1)r_k} and let x_(k+1) be the unique minimizer of ‖x_*-z‖_A over z∈ x_k+K_s(A,r_k). Each such minimization is one restart block, so k counts blocks. For a nonterminating orbit, define y_k=(r_k)/(‖r_k‖_2), ‖v‖_2=(v^T v)^(1/2). Determine the smallest positive integer s for which there exist n,A,b,x_0 as above such that r_k≠0 for every k≥0, but (y_(2k))_(k≥0) does not converge in Euclidean norm. Return +∞ if no such integer exists.
reference_description_ja: 再始動共役勾配法で偶数・奇数番目の残差方向がそれぞれ収束する再始動長と、収束しない長さを分類する。

problem:
Let \(I=\{4,6,8,\dots\}\cup\{\infty\}\). For each finite \(m\in I\), set
\[
R_m=\sqrt{\frac{2\pi}{m\sin(2\pi/m)}},
\]
and let \(P_m\subset\mathbb R^2\) be the interior of the convex hull of the points
\[
R_m\bigl(\cos((2k+1)\pi/m),\sin((2k+1)\pi/m)\bigr),\qquad k=0,\dots,m-1.
\]
Set \(P_\infty=\{x\in\mathbb R^2:\|x\|_2<1\}\). Thus every member of this family is a centrally symmetric convex domain of area \(\pi\).

For any domain \(\Omega\) in this family, define
\[
F_\Omega(\xi)=\int_\Omega e^{i\xi\cdot x}\,dx,\qquad
\kappa(\Omega)=\inf\{\|\xi\|_2:\xi\in\mathbb R^2,\ F_\Omega(\xi)=0\},
\]
where \(dx\) is planar Lebesgue measure, the inner product and norm are Euclidean, and \(\inf\varnothing=+\infty\).

Determine the unique maximizing index \(m_*\in I\) satisfying
\[
\kappa(P_{m_*})=\sup_{m\in I}\kappa(P_m).
\]
title: 正多角形のフーリエ変換
authors: Javier Gómez-Serrano; Michael Levitin; Daniel Platt; Iosif Polterovich
paper_title: An isoperimetric problem for Fourier zeros of centrally symmetric convex bodies
translation_ja: I={4,6,8,…}∪{∞}とする。有限のm∈IについてRₘ=√(2π/[m sin(2π/m)])とし、点Rₘ(cos((2k+1)π/m),sin((2k+1)π/m))、k=0,…,m−1の凸包の内部をPₘ⊂ℝ²とする。P∞={x∈ℝ²:‖x‖₂<1}とする。いずれも面積πの中心対称な凸領域である。この族の領域Ωに対し、FΩ(ξ)=∫Ω exp(iξ·x)dx、κ(Ω)=inf{‖ξ‖₂:ξ∈ℝ²,FΩ(ξ)=0}と定める。dxは平面ルベーグ測度で、内積とノルムはユークリッドのもの、inf∅=+∞とする。κ(Pₘ*)=supₘ∈I κ(Pₘ)を満たす、κ(Pₘ)を最大にする唯一のm*∈Iを求めよ。
display_original: Let I={4,6,8,…}∪{∞}. For each finite m∈ I, set R_m=√((2π)/(m sin(2π/m))), and let P_m⊂ℝ^2 be the interior of the convex hull of the points R_m( cos((2k+1)π/m), sin((2k+1)π/m)), k=0,…,m-1. Set P_∞={x∈ℝ^2:‖x‖_2<1}. Thus every member of this family is a centrally symmetric convex domain of area π. For any domain Ω in this family, define F_Ω(ξ)=∫_Ω e^(iξ· x) dx, κ(Ω)=inf{‖ξ‖_2:ξ∈ℝ^2, F_Ω(ξ)=0}, where dx is planar Lebesgue measure, the inner product and norm are Euclidean, and inf∅=+∞. Determine the unique maximizing index m_*∈ I satisfying κ(P_(m_*))=sup_(m∈ I)κ(P_m).
reference_description_ja: 凸体のフーリエ変換の零点を調べ、平面の中心対称な正多角形の中で正十二角形が最適と示す。

problem:
Work in the Euclidean plane with the lattice \(\mathbb Z^2\) of points having integer coordinates. All circles may have arbitrary real centers and positive radii. For a nonnegative integer \(n\), an \(n\)-circle is a circle whose open interior contains exactly \(n\) lattice points; lattice points on its circumference are not counted. An \(n\)-circle is called largest if its radius is at least the radius of every other \(n\)-circle. Call \(n\) strong if a largest \(n\)-circle exists but no largest \((n+1)\)-circle exists.

For a circle \(C\), let \(D(C)=C\cap\mathbb Z^2\) be its set of boundary lattice points. Say that \(D(C)\) has a mirror symmetry if reflection across some affine line in the plane maps \(D(C)\) onto itself.

Determine the smallest strong integer \(n\) for which there exists a largest \(n\)-circle \(C\) such that \(D(C)\) has no mirror symmetry.
title: 対称性を持たない最大円
paper_title: Largest Circle Enclosing Exactly $n$ Interior Lattice Points. II
translation_ja: 整数格子ℤ²を持つユークリッド平面を考える。円の中心は任意の実座標、半径は正とする。非負整数nについて、開いた内部にちょうどn個の格子点を含む円をn円と呼ぶ。円周上の格子点は数えない。ほかのどのn円の半径以上の半径を持つn円を最大と呼ぶ。最大n円は存在するが最大(n+1)円は存在しないとき、nを強いと呼ぶ。円Cの円周上の格子点集合をD(C)=C∩ℤ²とする。平面内のあるアフィン直線に関する鏡映がD(C)をそれ自身に移すとき、D(C)は鏡映対称性を持つとする。D(C)が鏡映対称性を持たない最大n円Cが存在するような、最小の強い整数nを求めよ。
display_original: Work in the Euclidean plane with the lattice ℤ^2 of points having integer coordinates. All circles may have arbitrary real centers and positive radii. For a nonnegative integer n, an n-circle is a circle whose open interior contains exactly n lattice points; lattice points on its circumference are not counted. An n-circle is called largest if its radius is at least the radius of every other n-circle. Call n strong if a largest n-circle exists but no largest (n+1)-circle exists. For a circle C, let D(C)=C∩ℤ^2 be its set of boundary lattice points. Say that D(C) has a mirror symmetry if reflection across some affine line in the plane maps D(C) onto itself. Determine the smallest strong integer n for which there exists a largest n-circle C such that D(C) has no mirror symmetry.
reference_description_ja: 一定数の格子点を囲む最大円を調べ、存在する個数の無限性と対称性の予想への反例を示す。

problem:
For complex \(q\) with \(|q|<1\), define
\[
P(q)=\prod_{m=0}^{\infty}\frac{(1-q^{8m+1})(1-q^{8m+7})}{(1-q^{8m+3})(1-q^{8m+5})}.
\]
For each real \(\delta\), define the coefficients \(c_\delta(n)\) by
\[
\exp(\delta\log P(q))=\sum_{n=0}^{\infty}c_\delta(n)q^n,
\]
where \(\log P(q)\) is the holomorphic logarithm on the open unit disk normalized by \(\log P(0)=0\). Set
\[
(\sigma_0,\sigma_1,\sigma_2,\sigma_3,\sigma_4,\sigma_5,\sigma_6,\sigma_7)=(1,-1,1,1,-1,1,-1,-1).
\]
Determine, as an exact interval, the set of all exponents \(\delta\in(2,4]\) for which
\[
\sigma_r c_\delta(8m+r)\ge 0
\]
for every integer \(m\ge0\) and every \(r\in\{0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7\}\). Zero coefficients are allowed.
title: 無限積の係数の符号
paper_title: Sign patterns of real powers of infinite products: resolution of four conjectures of Schlosser and Zhou
translation_ja: |q|<1の複素数qについてP(q)=∏ₘ₌₀∞[(1−q^(8m+1))(1−q^(8m+7))]/[(1−q^(8m+3))(1−q^(8m+5))]と定める。実数δごとにexp(δ log P(q))=Σₙ₌₀∞cδ(n)qⁿで係数cδ(n)を定める。log P(q)は開単位円板上の正則対数で、log P(0)=0に正規化する。(σ₀,…,σ₇)=(1,−1,1,1,−1,1,−1,−1)と置く。すべての整数m≥0とr∈{0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7}でσᵣcδ(8m+r)≥0が成り立つ指数δ∈(2,4]の集合を、厳密な区間として求めよ。係数0は許す。
display_original: For complex q with |q|<1, define P(q)=∏_(m=0)^(∞)((1-q^(8m+1))(1-q^(8m+7)))/((1-q^(8m+3))(1-q^(8m+5))). For each real δ, define the coefficients c_δ(n) by exp(δ log P(q))=Σ_(n=0)^(∞)c_δ(n)q^n, where log P(q) is the holomorphic logarithm on the open unit disk normalized by log P(0)=0. Set (σ_0,σ_1,σ_2,σ_3,σ_4,σ_5,σ_6,σ_7)=(1,-1,1,1,-1,1,-1,-1). Determine, as an exact interval, the set of all exponents δ∈(2,4] for which σ_r c_δ(8m+r)≥ 0 for every integer m≥0 and every r∈{0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7}. Zero coefficients are allowed.
reference_description_ja: 無限積の実数乗に現れる係数の符号パターンについて、四つの予想を解決する。

problem:
Let \(X=(x_{ij})_{i,j=1}^{3}\) and \(Y=(y_{ij})_{i,j=1}^{3}\) have eighteen algebraically independent commuting indeterminates over \(\mathbb R\) as entries. For a \(3\times3\) matrix \(A=(a_{ij})\), define its permanent by
\[
\operatorname{per}(A)=\sum_{\sigma\in S_3}\prod_{i=1}^{3}a_{i,\sigma(i)},
\]
where \(S_3\) is the set of all permutations of \(\{1,2,3\}\), and let \(\det(A)\) denote the usual determinant. For a sign matrix \(S=(s_{ij})\in\{-1,1\}^{3\times3}\), define the entrywise product \(S\circ A=(s_{ij}a_{ij})\).

Determine the smallest positive integer \(k\) for which there exist sign matrices \(S_1,\ldots,S_k,T_1,\ldots,T_k\in\{-1,1\}^{3\times3}\) and real constants \(c_1,\ldots,c_k\), independent of all eighteen indeterminates, such that the polynomial identity
\[
\operatorname{per}(X)\operatorname{per}(Y)=\sum_{t=1}^{k}c_t\det(S_t\circ X)\det(T_t\circ Y)
\]
holds.
title: パーマネントと行列式
translation_ja: X=(xᵢⱼ)、Y=(yᵢⱼ)、i,j=1,2,3の18個の成分は、ℝ上で代数的に独立な可換不定元とする。3×3行列A=(aᵢⱼ)のパーマネントをper(A)=Σσ∈S₃ ∏ᵢ₌₁³ aᵢ,σ(i)と定める。S₃は{1,2,3}の置換全体で、det(A)は通常の行列式を表す。符号行列S=(sᵢⱼ)∈{−1,1}³ˣ³に対しS∘A=(sᵢⱼaᵢⱼ)を成分ごとの積とする。18個の不定元によらない実定数c₁,…,cₖと符号行列S₁,…,Sₖ,T₁,…,Tₖが存在し、per(X)per(Y)=Σₜ₌₁ᵏcₜdet(Sₜ∘X)det(Tₜ∘Y)が多項式恒等式として成り立つ最小の正整数kを求めよ。
display_original: Let X=(x_(ij))_(i,j=1)^(3) and Y=(y_(ij))_(i,j=1)^(3) have eighteen algebraically independent commuting indeterminates over ℝ as entries. For a 3×3 matrix A=(a_(ij)), define its permanent by per(A)=Σ_(σ∈ S_3)∏_(i=1)^(3)a_(i,σ(i)), where S_3 is the set of all permutations of {1,2,3}, and let det(A) denote the usual determinant. For a sign matrix S=(s_(ij))∈{-1,1}^(3×3), define the entrywise product S∘ A=(s_(ij)a_(ij)). Determine the smallest positive integer k for which there exist sign matrices S_1,…,S_k,T_1,…,T_k∈{-1,1}^(3×3) and real constants c_1,…,c_k, independent of all eighteen indeterminates, such that the polynomial identity per(X)per(Y)=Σ_(t=1)^(k)c_tdet(S_t∘ X)det(T_t∘ Y) holds.
reference_description_ja: 完全マッチング多項式を表すPfaffianの最小個数が13となるグラフを構成する。

problem:
All graphs are finite, simple, and undirected. Cycles are considered as subgraphs, not necessarily induced subgraphs. A graph homomorphism from \(G\) to \(H\) is a map \(f:V(G)\to V(H)\) such that \(f(u)f(v)\in E(H)\) whenever \(uv\in E(G)\); the map need not be injective.

For a real number \(c\in[0,1]\), consider the following property: there exists a finite graph \(H_c\) containing no cycle of length \(3\) such that, for every integer \(n\geq1\), every graph \(G\) on \(n\) vertices containing no cycle of length \(3\) or \(5\), and in which every vertex has at least \(cn\) neighbors, admits a homomorphism to \(H_c\). The graph \(H_c\) may depend on \(c\), but not on \(n\) or \(G\).

What is the exact infimum of the numbers \(c\in[0,1]\) having this property?
title: グラフ準同型の次数条件
authors: Romain Bourneuf; Raphael Steiner; Stéphan Thomassé; Yuval Wigderson
paper_title: Asymmetric Homomorphism Thresholds for Graphs of Large Odd Girth
translation_ja: グラフはすべて有限・単純・無向とし、閉路は誘導部分グラフとは限らない。GからHへのグラフ準同型とは、uv∈E(G)ならf(u)f(v)∈E(H)となる写像f:V(G)→V(H)で、単射である必要はない。実数c∈[0,1]について次の性質を考える。長さ3の閉路を含まない有限グラフHcが存在し、任意の整数n≥1と、長さ3または5の閉路を含まず、各頂点が少なくともcn個の隣接頂点を持つn頂点グラフGが、Hcへの準同型を持つ。Hcはcに依存してよいが、nやGには依存しない。この性質を持つc∈[0,1]の下限を厳密に求めよ。
display_original: All graphs are finite, simple, and undirected. Cycles are considered as subgraphs, not necessarily induced subgraphs. A graph homomorphism from G to H is a map f:V(G)→ V(H) such that f(u)f(v)∈ E(H) whenever uv∈ E(G); the map need not be injective. For a real number c∈[0,1], consider the following property: there exists a finite graph H_c containing no cycle of length 3 such that, for every integer n≥1, every graph G on n vertices containing no cycle of length 3 or 5, and in which every vertex has at least cn neighbors, admits a homomorphism to H_c. The graph H_c may depend on c, but not on n or G. What is the exact infimum of the numbers c∈[0,1] having this property?
reference_description_ja: 長さ3・5の閉路を持たないグラフから三角形のないグラフへの準同型の次数閾値を1/9と示す。

problem:
For each integer \(k\in\{1,2,\ldots,14\}\), set \(L=8k+3\) and \(h=4k+2\), and index length-\(L\) sequences by \(0,1,\ldots,L-1\). Define \(q\in\{-1,1\}^L\) by setting \(q_i=-1\) exactly at the three indices \(h-1,h,L-1\), and \(q_i=1\) elsewhere.

For any \(x\in\{-1,1\}^L\), define its half-flip \(x^*\) by \(x_i^*=x_i\) for \(i<h\) and \(x_i^*=-x_i\) for \(i\ge h\). Multiplication of sequences is coordinatewise, so \((sq)_i=s_iq_i\). For \(1\le d<L\), define the aperiodic autocorrelation
\[
C_d(x)=\sum_{i=0}^{L-1-d}x_i x_{i+d},
\]
with no wrap-around of indices.

Determine the finite set of all such integers \(k\) for which there exists \(s\in\{-1,1\}^L\) satisfying
\[
C_d(s)+C_d(s^*)+C_d(sq)+C_d((sq)^*)=0
\]
for every \(d=1,2,\ldots,L-1\).
title: 自己相関を打ち消す列
paper_title: An explicit half-flip family of 32-modular Hadamard matrices at L = 3 mod 8: structural placement and mod-tower analysis
translation_ja: k∈{1,…,14}ごとにL=8k+3、h=4k+2と置き、長さLの列に0,…,L−1の添字を付ける。q∈{−1,1}ᴸを、添字h−1,h,L−1だけでqᵢ=−1、それ以外でqᵢ=1となるよう定める。x∈{−1,1}ᴸの半反転x*を、i<hならx*ᵢ=xᵢ、i≥hならx*ᵢ=−xᵢで定める。列の積は成分ごと、すなわち(sq)ᵢ=sᵢqᵢとする。1≤d<Lについて非周期自己相関をC_d(x)=Σᵢ₌₀^(L−1−d)xᵢxᵢ₊dと定め、添字は巡回させない。すべてのd=1,…,L−1でC_d(s)+C_d(s*)+C_d(sq)+C_d((sq)*)=0となるs∈{−1,1}ᴸが存在するkをすべて求めよ。

Multiplication of sequences is coordinatewise, so (sq)_i=s_iq_i. For 1≤ d<L, define the aperiodic autocorrelation C_d(x)=Σ_(i=0)^(L-1-d)x_i x_(i+d), with no wrap-around of indices. reference_description_ja: 列の半反転と自己相関の恒等式を使い、32を法とするHadamard行列の明示的な族を構成する。

problem:
All graphs in this question are finite, nonempty, simple, and undirected. A graph is planar if it admits a drawing in the plane in which edges meet only at common endpoints.

Let \(\mathcal B\) be the class of graphs \(G=(V,E)\) satisfying both conditions:
1. There exist planar graphs \(P_1=(V,E_1)\) and \(P_2=(V,E_2)\) such that \(E=E_1\cup E_2\). The edge sets may overlap, and the two planar drawings are chosen independently.
2. No three distinct vertices of \(G\) are pairwise nonadjacent.

For a graph \(G\), define its chromatic number \(\chi(G)\) to be the least positive integer \(k\) for which there is a map \(c:V\to\{1,\ldots,k\}\) satisfying \(c(u)\ne c(v)\) for every edge \(uv\in E\).

Determine the exact value of \(\max_{G\in\mathcal B}\chi(G)\).
title: 二つの平面グラフの彩色
paper_title: Biplanar graphs with independence number two are 9-colorable
translation_ja: グラフは有限・非空・単純・無向とする。平面グラフとは、辺どうしが共通の端点以外で交わらないよう平面に描けるグラフである。クラスBは次の二条件を満たすG=(V,E)からなる。(1) 平面グラフP₁=(V,E₁)、P₂=(V,E₂)が存在しE=E₁∪E₂となる。辺集合は重なってよく、二つの平面描画は独立に選ぶ。(2) どの異なる3頂点を選んでも、少なくとも一組は隣接する。彩色数χ(G)を、すべての辺uvでc(u)≠c(v)となる写像c:V→{1,…,k}が存在する最小の正整数kとする。max_G∈B χ(G)の厳密な値を求めよ。

problem:
Work in the Euclidean plane \(\mathbb R^2\) with its standard metric. Set
\[
\delta=\frac{1}{500000},\qquad u(x,y)=\frac{480x+31y}{481},\qquad v(x,y)=\frac{-31x+480y}{481}.
\]
Consider the three conics
\[
\begin{aligned}
Q_0:&\quad x^2-\frac{25}{3}xy+\frac{600}{29}y^2-\frac{15}{2}x-\frac{2975}{29}y+\frac{25}{2}=0,\\
Q_1:&\quad y^2-\delta^2(x+\frac34)^2+\delta^4=0,\\
Q_2:&\quad v(x,y)^2-\delta^2(u(x,y)-\frac{297}{323})^2+\delta^4=0.
\end{aligned}
\]
A real circle means a locus
\[
C_{a,b,r}:\quad (x-a)^2+(y-b)^2=r^2,
\qquad a,b\in\mathbb R,\quad r>0.
\]
Tangency to a conic means that the circle and the conic share a point in \(\mathbb R^2\) at which their tangent lines coincide. Count each distinct circle once, without orientation or algebraic multiplicity and regardless of the choice of contact points. What is the exact number of real circles simultaneously tangent to \(Q_0,Q_1,Q_2\)?
title: 三つの円錐曲線への接円
authors: Haoyang Liu; Tianle Liu; Guorui Xu; Fan Yang
paper_title: Two-flag degenerations and real circles tangent to three conics
translation_ja: 標準計量を持つユークリッド平面ℝ²で考える。δ=1/500000、u(x,y)=(480x+31y)/481、v(x,y)=(−31x+480y)/481と置く。三つの円錐曲線をQ₀: x²−(25/3)xy+(600/29)y²−(15/2)x−(2975/29)y+25/2=0、Q₁: y²−δ²(x+3/4)²+δ⁴=0、Q₂: v(x,y)²−δ²(u(x,y)−297/323)²+δ⁴=0とする。実円とは(x−a)²+(y−b)²=r²、a,b∈ℝ、r>0という軌跡を指す。円と円錐曲線が接するとは、ℝ²内の共通点で接線が一致することをいう。向きや代数的重複度は考えず、接点の選び方にもよらず、異なる円を一度ずつ数える。Q₀,Q₁,Q₂すべてに同時に接する実円は厳密に何個あるか。

reference_description_ja: 三つの円錐曲線に同時に接する実円が160個となる具体例を構成し、136個以下という予想を覆す。

problem: Consider finite simple undirected graphs with at least two vertices; connectivity is not required. A triangle is an unordered set of three distinct vertices with all three possible edges present. For each vertex v of a graph G, let τ_G(v) be the number of triangles containing v, counting each triangle once. Determine the least nonnegative integer r for which there exists such a graph G in which every vertex has exactly r neighbors and the numbers τ_G(v), as v ranges over all vertices, are pairwise distinct.
title: 正則グラフの頂点ごとの三角形数
authors: Artem Hak; Sergiy Kozerenko; Andrii Serdiuk
translation_ja: 頂点が少なくとも二つある有限・単純・無向グラフを考える。連結性は仮定しない。三角形とは、互いにすべて隣接する異なる3頂点の順序を考えない集合である。グラフGの各頂点vについて、vを含む三角形の数をτG(v)とし、各三角形は一度だけ数える。すべての頂点がちょうどr個の隣接頂点を持ち、全頂点にわたる数τG(v)が互いに異なるようなグラフGが存在する、最小の非負整数rを求めよ。
display_original: Consider finite simple undirected graphs with at least two vertices; connectivity is not required. A triangle is an unordered set of three distinct vertices with all three possible edges present. For each vertex v of a graph G, let τ_G(v) be the number of triangles containing v, counting each triangle once. Determine the least nonnegative integer r for which there exists such a graph G in which every vertex has exactly r neighbors and the numbers τ_G(v), as v ranges over all vertices, are pairwise distinct.
reference_description_ja: 三角形数が全頂点で異なる8正則グラフが存在しないことを証明し、存在の次数閾値を9に定める。
